definition: Atomic force microscopy: topography and roughness.
A value computed from other values (not a measurement).
A value taken from another work (not a measurement).
Electron probe microanalysis: an electron microprobe's X-ray elemental maps and line scans across a polished cross section (comparable in kind with SEM-EDS line scans: class eds).
Electrostatic quadrupole plasma analyser: ion energies and masses in the plasma.
Four-point probe sheet resistance of a film, turned into resistivity with the film thickness (in-plane).
Transmission Fourier transform infrared absorption of surface species on a porous sample during the half-reactions (in situ).

Grazing-incidence wide-angle X-ray scattering: a 2D diffraction pattern of a thin film at grazing incidence (synchrotron), azimuthally integrated to a 1D XRD profile; phases, texture (preferred orientation) and crystallite size.
Weighing before and after deposition.
Hall measurement in the van der Pauw geometry: carrier density and mobility.
Infrared light microscopy through a silicon membrane: top-view images of the film extent in a lateral cavity (silicon is transparent in the infrared).
Optical emission spectroscopy of the plasma.
Optical microscope images.
A photograph of the specimen.
The reactor's own gauges and thermocouples: pressure and temperature traces during the process.
Raman spectroscopy: phonon modes, used for crystallinity and phase.
Rutherford backscattering spectrometry (with elastic recoil detection for H): areal atomic densities and composition.
Spectroscopic reflectometry: film thickness from the reflectance spectrum at a spot.
A drawing: a value or statement read from a schematic (not a measurement).
Scanning electron microscopy images.
Energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy in a scanning electron microscope: elemental maps and line scans.
Secondary ion mass spectrometry depth profiling: elemental concentrations (atoms per cm3) against depth.
A value produced by a model run (not a measurement).
Spectroscopic ellipsometry: film thickness and optical constants from the polarization change on reflection, in situ or ex situ (the mode qualifier).
A value stated in a table without a method (not a measurement).
Transmission electron microscopy images of a cross-section.
Energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy in a (scanning) transmission electron microscope: elemental maps and line integrals of a cross-section.
Time-of-flight elastic recoil detection analysis: elemental composition and depth profiles in at.%, hydrogen included, from a heavy-ion beam.
Current-voltage characteristics of a field-effect transistor made from the film.
Two-contact resistance through the thickness of a body between blanket electrodes on its faces, turned into volume resistivity with the electrode area and the thickness.
UV-visible transmission spectrophotometry of a film on a transparent substrate: transmittance against wavelength, and the Tauc plot for the optical band gap.
X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy: surface composition and chemical states.
X-ray diffraction: crystalline phases, phase fractions and crystallite sizes.
X-ray reflectivity: thickness, density and roughness from the specular reflectivity curve.
